nick_ops: small spike in embed 503s in eu-west1 after recent routing tweak. I have a 2-line fix: null-check + extend cache TTL. Image: `redwood/embeds:2026-03-23-hf-d`. Need expedited signoff for a 30m window.
lara_release: paste plan and rollback. pinging @mike_sre for smoke.
nick_ops: Plan: canary 5% -> 25% (10m) -> 100% (15m). Rollback: redeploy `redwood/embeds:2026-03-18-prod` and pin. Smoke: end-to-end embed, p99 < 650ms, kv_hit > 0.6. Staging passed.
mike_sre: I'll run prod shadow now, ETA 3m.
releasebot: deploy request: promote redwood/embeds:2026-03-23-hf-d -> eu-west1-embed-canary. Window immediate, 30m total.
deploybot: starting canary (5%).
mike_sre: shadow smoke ok: p99=480ms kv_hit=0.68, no 5xx in 6m. +1 SRE.
lara_release: +1 release lead. pin will be applied.
deploybot: bumping to 25%.
nick_ops: metrics: errors down 72% in canary.
mike_sre: 25% stable for 11m. approve full roll.
deploybot: rolling to 100% now.
releasebot: applied image pin and toggled dedicated_autoupdate=false.
deploybot: rollout complete. image `2026-03-23-hf-d` at 100% eu-west1. Health checks green.
lara_release: publishing release note and tagging support. keep pin for 8h.
nick_ops: thanks all, closing. :shipit:
